recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,387.40 (+0.38%) and the Sensex at 82,532.19 (+0.52%); Bank Nifty moved +1.13%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +0.36%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +0.27%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.09%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹4,195 cr and DIIs net buyers of ₹197 cr (provisional, NSE).
PSU Bank led the sectors (+1.95%), while IT lagged (-0.90%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Brainbees Solutions (+12.85%); biggest faller was Urban Company (-5.86%). Breadth: 261 advances vs 238 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 1.92% and the Nasdaq down 2.49%.
The rupee is at 93.46 per dollar, Brent at $93.27 (+0.90%) and gold at $3,860 (+0.19%).
